info.title: FieldLoop internal mock pump and gate status
info.description: Simulated read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local reads need no credentials. No live public API, no real pump SCADA connector and no write operation. A reading reaches the platform only as a signal.v1 message published in process.

servers.description: Local simulator as the repository README starts it. Deployed environments call the private simulator-{env} Cloud Run service with a Google OIDC ID token.

get.description: Return the simulated operating state and power status at asOf of one synthetic pump (P-1, P-2, P-3) or gate (G-1, G-2). The status is a pure function of the Facility and asOf, plus any Scenario power change; the clock is the caller's asOf, never wall time. It commands nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset code of a pump or gate, for example P-3. Any other value is 404.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Timezone-aware Scenario time, not wall time; the response reports it in UTC as observedAt. The default is the start of the Bangkok storm simulation, fixed for deterministic replay.

400.description: Invalid asOf, or an undeclared or repeated query parameter; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

404.description: Unknown pump or gate; code not_found.

405.description: Only GET is served, so every other method is refused; code method_not_allowed, and Allow names the methods the path serves. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
